## ZXP Manager

Install, audit and cleanly uninstall Adobe CEP/UXP extensions. A modernised, **vibe-coded** fork of [ZXPInstaller](https://github.com/elements-storage/ZXPInstaller). See the [README](https://github.com/taehas/ZXPInstaller#readme) for features and limits.

### Read this first

- **AI-written, lightly tested.** Developed and tested on macOS (Apple Silicon) with Creative Cloud 2026 apps. The **Windows build is untested**, and so are the Intel Mac build and Windows paths.
- **Builds are unsigned and not notarised.**
  - **macOS:** if it says the app is damaged or from an unidentified developer, right-click the app, choose Open, or run `xattr -cr "/Applications/ZXP Manager.app"`.
  - **Windows:** SmartScreen will warn. Choose *More info → Run anyway*.
- Nothing is hard-deleted: removals go to the Trash and every destructive action asks first.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `ZXP.Manager-*-mac-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS, Intel | `ZXP.Manager-*-mac-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
